title: Lesson audit entry v1
description: One line of <slug>.audit.jsonl. Entries are only appended; each carries the digest of the previous one, so removing or editing one breaks the chain (scripts/lessons check).

n.description: Position in the trail, from 1; entries are only ever appended.

by.description: Who changed it: a tool or a lane.

prev.description: The digest of the previous entry (lessons.genesis_digest for the first).

digest.description: lessons.digest_algorithm of this entry without digest, chained through prev.
